# temps_backup_destination (Resource)

An S3-compatible bucket Temps writes backups to (AWS S3, MinIO, RustFS, ...).

The server never returns the credentials (they read back as `***`), so the provider keeps the configured values and cannot detect credential changes made outside Terraform. Destroying a destination that still holds backups fails unless `force_destroy = true`, which deletes those backups first.

Required API key permissions: `backups:create`, `backups:read`, `backups:write`, `backups:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_backup_destination" "s3" {
  name             = "backups"
  bucket_name      = "temps-backups"
  bucket_path      = "production"
  endpoint         = "https://s3.example.com"
  region           = "us-east-1"
  force_path_style = true
  access_key_id    = var.backup_access_key_id
  secret_key       = var.backup_secret_key
  is_default       = true

  # Check the credentials and bucket on every apply.
  verify_on_apply = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID.
- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket name. The bucket must already exist.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key.

### Optional

- `bucket_path` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket. Defaults to the bucket root.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint URL for S3-compatible servers, for example `https://s3.example.com`. Omit for AWS S3.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) On destroy, permanently delete the backups stored in this destination first. Without it, destroying a destination that holds backups fails.
- `force_path_style` (Boolean) Use path-style addressing (`endpoint/bucket/key`), which most self-hosted servers need.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Make this the default destination (used by schedules without `s3_source_id`). Temps makes the first destination the default automatically. Only `true` can be set. Temps does not delete the default while other destinations exist: when they are destroyed in the same run, the provider waits up to two minutes for them before deleting the default.
- `region` (String) Bucket region. Defaults to `us-east-1`, which most S3-compatible servers accept.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Whether to connect with TLS. Not returned by the server; the configured value is kept.
- `verify_on_apply` (Boolean) Check the credentials and bucket before saving, and fail the apply when they do not work.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric destination ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_backup_destination.s3 3
```
